contexts.text: They immersed the truths of the Church... in their cupidities. AC 571. AC 581. AC 582. AC 586. AC 794:2. AC 863:end.

That care ought to be especially taken that he does not immerse the goods and truths of faith in cupidities; that is, that he does not confirm evils and falsities by means of the goods and truths which are of the internal man. Treated of.
They who are immersed in corporeal and earthly things...
For they have immersed their thoughts in such things as are of the world... Their thought is kept... immersed in terms...
When he is too much immersed in worldly and corporeal things...
They are immersed no deeper in their evils aid falsities than...
Foresight as to how much they would be immersed in falsities. Signified.
Griefs = immersion in falsities. For those who are in good, when they are immersed in falsities... are tortured.
These are perpetually immersed in falsities.
In the other life immersion in falsities appears like one who is immersed in waves... The immersion which takes place with the wicked appears like a mistiness more or less dusky...
Their immersion in the sea Suph.
It treats of the immersion in Hell of those who are in faith separated from charity... AC 8137:3. AC 8138. AC 8232.
Hell is signified by the sea Suph in which the Egyptians were immersed.
That they immersed themselves in falsities from evil. Signified.
That they immerse or enclose themselves. References.
For man at this day is so immersed in the body...
To be immersed in the sea = to be immersed in scientifics from worldly and earthly things even to the denial of truth Divine. Illustrated.
Nor to immerse his Rational...
He is immersed in what is corporeal...
The love of self, in which they have immersed these things.
It is immersed in thoughts about self...
That the total washing which took place by means of immersion in the waters of Jordan = regeneration itself, in like manner as baptism. References.
He who continually immerses his thoughts in his proprium...
Because they have immersed the love of their will and the understanding together with it in the uncleannesses of scortatory love...

The corporeal immerse all things of the will and thence of the understanding in the body... But the sensuous immerse all things of the will and thence of the understanding in the allurements and fallacies of the senses.
As they immersed their minds in worldly and corporeal things...
He cannot but be immersed in Hell, and submerged.
They immerse their wills and thoughts... in proprium.
On the penalty of some who are immersed as it were in deep mists.
Then the man immerses the interiors of his mind... in his own proprium; and when a man is immersed in his own proprium he thinks and wills from Hell.
He is condemned by means of the immersions of his thoughts in Societies of Hell.
